newsitem.title: USA: Computer Horizons files for 3 mln shares.
newsitem.headline: Computer Horizons files for 3 mln shares.

text.p: Computer Horizons Corp filed Thursday with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission to register an offering of up to three million shares, of which the company will sell 2.5 million shares and a group of shareholders will sell 500,000 shares.
Underwriters for the offering, Alex Brown & Sons Inc, UBS Securities, Furman Selz and Punk Ziegel & Co, have an over-allotment option of up to 450,000 shares.
The Mountain Lakes, N.J., information technology services company said it will use the proceeds from the sale for general corporate needs.
After the offering, the company will have 27,057,374 shares outstanding.
